title: US sanctions Indian firms, individuals as Iran oil crackdown widens
content: On Thursday, the United States targeted two Mumbai-based companies over their alleged oil trade involvement with Iran. The sanctions affected five Indian nationals connected to SSPL Solutions Private Limited and Samudra Marine Services Private Limited. These measures are part of a broader crackdown on Iran under 'Operation Economic Outcast'. The U.S. government aims to curb Iranian oil revenues fueling military and cyber activities.

title: Nana Patekar cremated with full state honours, fans bid tearful farewell
content: The Indian film industry mourns the loss of Nana Patekar, who succumbed to cardiac arrest as confirmed by his son. The actor's passing, attributed to natural causes, prompted the Maharashtra government to orchestrate a state funeral fitting his legacy in cinema. Tributes poured in from fans and fellow actors in Pune, with many sharing their fond memories of the beloved artist on social media.

title: 'Contest UP polls from Ayodhya': Akhilesh Yadav dares CM Yogi Adityanath
content: Akhilesh Yadav has urged Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath to contest the upcoming assembly elections from Ayodhya. He indicated plans to visit the Ram temple alongside SP leaders after visiting Kedareshwar Dham in Etawah. Yadav also noted that the BJP has been conducting surveys for the Ayodhya seat, claiming they are struggling to find a candidate to challenge him. This statement responds to BJP allegations about his temple visitations.

title: 'Welcome to India': Rahul reacts to Musk's remarks; Starlink boss says 'thank you'
content: Rahul Gandhi has weighed in on Elon Musk's comments about the hold-up of Starlink's commercial operations in India. Musk voiced his exasperation over regulatory obstacles, suggesting that oligarchs sway the industry. The government swiftly countered, emphasising the fairness of its regulations among satellite operators and underlining the importance of security compliance for safeguarding users and data alike.

title: US suspends Microsoft from Green Card programme, here is what the company has to say
content: The US has suspended Microsoft from the Permanent Labor Certification Program (PERM), freezing new and pending Green Card applications for its foreign workers. Vice President JD Vance accused Microsoft of abusing the H-1B and PERM system to replace laid-off American workers. Microsoft says 80% of its roughly 6,000 H-1B filings last fiscal year were for existing employees, and that it pays H-1B staff the same as others doing comparable work.

title: J&K: High court orders passport revival for student purusing MBBS in Iran
content: Ibra Khan, a student pursuing MBBS at Tehran University, had her passport impounded due to her father's past case. The Jammu & Kashmir High Court intervened, recognizing her completion of half the course before the impounding occurred. Legal representatives argued that Khan could not be held accountable for her father's actions from 1997. A division bench ordered the passport's revival while allowing authorities to impose conditions on its use.

title: US executive admits $193.6m fraud after FBI finds 298 gold bars
content: In a shocking turn of events, David J. Rush, a former high-ranking federal employee, has admitted guilt in a case of extensive fraud against the US government. Using his top-secret clearance, he concocted imaginary government projects to pocket nearly $194 million. His lavish spending spree included luxury objects and assets, leading to an FBI raid that uncovered gold bars and cash.

title: Bypoll election results: When and where to watch vote counting
content: Votes for five Assembly constituencies and the Nagaon Lok Sabha seat will be counted today. Counting will commence at 8am, with results announced throughout the day. Updates will be provided by the Election Commission of India on their official results website. The Times of India will also provide live coverage of the counting process and results. The counting will occur under security arrangements at the respective counting centres.

title: 'Unite to fight': Uddhav Sena to Kejriwal, Stalin; will AAP, DMK relent?
content: Uddhav Thackeray's Shiv Sena has called on AAP and DMK to join opposition forces against CEC Gyanesh Kumar over irregularities in SIR. Despite AAP's separation from the INDIA bloc and DMK's mixed reactions, the lack of participation from both factions underscores existing rifts in the opposition landscape. Analysts argue that these parties might still rally together to uphold democratic principles, though future collaboration remains clouded by their historical rivalries.

title: Jon Stewart and wife turned 45-acre New Jersey farm into animal sanctuary
content: In 2016, Jon Stewart and Tracey Stewart acquired Hockhockson Farm in Colts Neck, New Jersey, with the vision of establishing both a working farm and a sanctuary for rescued farm animals. Their ambitious plans include educational programs focused on sustainable farming and healthy eating. The property is equipped with barns and pastures, as well as facilities dedicated to animal care, successfully fulfilling its mission of promoting agriculture and welfare.

title: Shopper paid C$5 for painting; David Bowie original later sold for C$108,120
content: In an astonishing discovery, a seemingly unremarkable painting by David Bowie was acquired for just C$5 at a South River donation center. Once authenticated as DHead XLVI, the artwork soared to a staggering auction price of C$108,120. Experts linked it to Bowie's 1990s oeuvre, showcasing how opportunistic collectors can miss hidden treasures without knowledge of their past.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school; 10 years later, Board votes to close it
content: Priscilla Chan's Primary School in California, which aimed to support low-income families, has closed. The school shut down due to funding issues after receiving significant financial support over ten years. It was noted that academic results were mixed, and some features resembled a startup environment. Around 540 children were enrolled prior to the closure, affecting many local families.

title: Arnold Schwarzenegger donated $250,000 to build 25 shelters for homeless veterans
content: In 2021, Arnold Schwarzenegger donated $250,000 to Village for Vets to help provide temporary shelters for homeless veterans in Los Angeles. Before Christmas, 25 tiny shelters were installed at the VA campus in West Los Angeles. Each provided a bed, climate control, electricity and a locking door, giving veterans who had been living on the streets a safer place to stay while moving towards stable housing.

title: CJP claims Deepak Baliyan assaulted, brother injured; Rajasthan Police deny action
content: The Cockroach Janata Party reported that their co-incharge, Deepak Baliyan, was detained by Rajasthan Police. This incident occurred ahead of the planned protest in Delhi against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. While party leaders accused police of forceful detention, the police denied such claims. Protests against Kumar have also been held in Bengaluru by various activists and groups.

title: 5 injured after gas cylinder explodes at workers’ shed on IIT Bombay campus
content: A significant incident unfolded on Thursday night when a gas cylinder exploded in a workers' shed at an under-construction building on the IIT Powai campus. Occurring at approximately 10:24 PM in Hostel No. 6, five people sustained injuries—two minors and three adults. Fortunately, all individuals are reported to be in stable condition.

title: Travis Kelce’s NFL resurgence: How is he climbing the record book?
content: Travis Kelce had a quiet game with only two catches but moved past Tim Brown in receptions. The Kansas City Chiefs defeated the Raiders 30-27, improving their record to 4-0. Kelce now sits seven catches away from passing Cris Carter and Marvin Harrison in career receptions. His performance has been overshadowed by strong ground game contributions in this match.

title: Connor McDavid’s wife Lauren Kyle: How did she build her five-venture empire?
content: Lauren Kyle McDavid's entrepreneurial journey blossomed with her interior design firm, Kyle & Co. However, she initially struggled with the business side of her creativity. To support her, her husband, Connor McDavid, arranged sessions with a business coach. By June 2025, Lauren broadened her horizons, introducing projects like Sports Club Atelier and Trove Living, all while striving to craft meaningful experiences in her diverse portfolio.

title: Indians among hundreds to get share of $35m payout in labour 'exploitation' case
content: In a significant development, over 100 construction workers are about to be compensated in a settlement linked to Caddell Construction due to allegations of labor exploitation at the new US consulate in Milan. Workers endured illegal wage cutbacks, unpaid overtime, and deplorable working environments. Expected payouts will average near 45,000 euros, with select cases reaching an impressive 90,000 euros.

title: 'He was generous & brutally honest': Dimple Kapadia on Nana Patekar
content: "I’m glad I was directed by Nana in Prahaar", said the actress, mourning the loss of the legendary actor.

title: Ratan Tata’s beloved pet dog 'Goa' survives car accident outside Bombay House
content: Ratan Tata's pet dog Goa was injured in a car accident outside Bombay House on Thursday. After being given medical attention, Goa is reportedly recovering and shows signs of improvement. Noel Tata visited the injured dog to check on his wellbeing during this time. Goa is expected to participate in the Blessing of Pets ceremony on Sunday, October 11.

title: Bihar: Masked man removes jewellery from dead body, calmly walks away
content: A viral  video raises security concerns after a man allegedly removed a chain from a deceased body. The incident occurred at Siwan Model Sadar Hospital, where he approached the body near the registration counter. Following a similar previous complaint, security access to deceased patients is now under scrutiny. Hospital authorities are planning to examine the footage and take legal action if necessary.

title: Palestine factions could postpone elections amid Israeli complications, internal feud
content: Palestinian factions are contemplating a delay in the upcoming legislative elections initially set for November 28. This potential postponement is attributed to logistical challenges in Israeli-annexed East Jerusalem and Gaza following the recent war. President Mahmoud Abbas's Fatah party is part of discussions regarding the election timing and national consensus. The European Union has offered to deploy observers for the legislative elections.

title: Bengal, Tamil Nadu, Assam and Puducherry brace for closely watched bypoll verdicts
content: The bypolls were held on Tuesday, October 6, in Nandigram and Rejinagar in West Bengal, Madurantakam and Dharapuram in Tamil Nadu, Nagaon in Assam and Thattanchavady in Puducherry. Counting of votes in all six constituencies is scheduled for Friday, with the process beginning at 8 am. The results across these six contests, by the end of the day, would  provide more than individual winners and losers.

title: 'Death by restriction': As Trump sours H-1B visa dream, who faces biggest hit?
content: Three H-1B related changes are stacking on top of each other: the multiple $100,000 fee proposals, the wage-weighted lottery favoring more senior workers, new layoff and compliance scrutiny, and now the OPT/STEM-OPT $70,000 fee proposal for students looking to work in the US. The pathway is set to become much narrower or worse may even disappear!

title: PSL to clash with IPL again as PCB locks dates; BCCI also eyes early-March start
content: The Pakistan Super League (PSL) 12 is scheduled from March 18 to May 2, 2027, aligning with IPL 2027. The Pakistan Cricket Board has confirmed this timeline while maintaining the eight-team format. Notably, last season saw overseas players opted out in favor of IPL contracts, impacting the league's dynamics. In a fresh approach, this season will implement a player auction, enhancing fan engagement and building on last year’s success.

title: Nana Patekar’s mortal remains brought to Pune, Maha CM Fadnavis pays last respects
content: Nana Patekar, the iconic 75-year-old actor, has sadly died from a cardiac arrest at his residence in Goa. His remains were transported to Donje in Pune, where a state funeral has been arranged to honor his lasting legacy, as announced by Maharashtra’s Cultural Affairs Minister. The scene is expected to attract an influx of filmmakers and politicians who wish to pay their final tributes to the esteemed actor.

title: 'Dhappa' gets Day 3 twist as cops allow Rahul, INDIA bloc MPs to protest at Raj Ghat
content: Opposition leaders, after previously being stopped by police, successfully reached Raj Ghat for their protest. They staged a brief sit-in to honor Mahatma Gandhi while voicing their concerns about electoral integrity. Congress leaders accused the government and Election Commission of undermining democratic rights and engaging in a conspiracy. Rahul Gandhi emphasized the need for justice regarding these electoral issues.

title: Munir overrules Pak PM, to deploy more military assets to Riyadh under Mecca pact
content: Pakistan's defence forces chief Asim Munir has confirmed plans to deploy additional troops to Saudi Arabia. This deployment comes despite the country's parliament deciding against involvement in the Houthi conflict previously. The decision follows a recently signed Mecca defence pact between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey. Furthermore, Munir's increasing power and influence within the Pakistani political landscape are noteworthy.

title: Inside waqf land grab in Telangana: Fake NOCs, forged ORCs
content: The Telangana Waqf Board is dealing with issues related to fake no-objection certificates and forged occupancy rights certificates. These forged documents are allegedly being used to illegally acquire waqf land and secure approvals. In one instance, a fake NOC was presented to a district collector regarding land ownership. Officials are warning government agencies against accepting such fraudulent documents for any official transactions.

title: Serena Williams helped build Jamaica school giving free education to 80 kids
content: Serena Williams has taken an admirable step towards education by contributing to the Salt Marsh Basic School in Trelawny, Jamaica. This school provides free preschool education to local children, significantly improving their access to learning. By physically participating in the building process alongside other volunteers, Williams showcased the value of community collaboration in fostering educational growth and ensuring a safe space for the children.

title: California dad spent $3,500 building 180-foot backyard roller coaster for son
content: A California father constructed a 180-foot roller coaster for his son after the child expressed interest. They spent six weeks working on the project, which cost around $3,500 to complete. The father used the project as an educational opportunity to teach his son about physics and mathematics throughout the construction process. Neighbors became curious and followed the project as it progressed in their backyard.

title: Rockefeller fund matched $5m, helping create Great Smoky Mountains National Park
content: The establishment of Great Smoky Mountains National Park was a remarkable achievement that required overcoming significant financial challenges due to increasing land prices. Initial fundraising efforts gathered $5 million, but this amount quickly proved insufficient as prices soared. The Rockefeller family stepped in, matching previous contributions with an additional $5 million, allowing for crucial land acquisitions.

title: Haryana CM’s chopper parked in Gurgaon stadium, athletes lost access to tracks for 4 days
content: Athletes training at Tau Devi Lal Stadium faced significant disruption when a helicopter landed on the tracks for four days due to mechanical issues. This pattern of interruptions has alarmed the sports community, which is now urging for the establishment of a dedicated helipad. While solutions for a helihub are being considered, ensuring that athletes can train without disruption continues to be a primary concern.

title: GST Reforms: Arrest powers scrapped, refunds automated; businesses set to see faster relief
content: The GST Council approved a series of changes aimed at easing compliance, including removing the power of tax officials to make arrests and raising the prosecution threshold fivefold to Rs 5 crore. FM Nirmala Sitharaman said the GST Council had largely dealt with anomalies arising from input tax credit (ITC) and addressed the issue of duty inversion.

title: How IAF's first Hawai Sepoys came into being: Their story dates back to 1932
content: Before the Indian Air Force took its first flight in 1933, a lesser-known chapter of its history was already taking shape. The story of the Hawai Sepoys goes back to the early years of the force, when finding and training skilled personnel was among its first challenges. Their journey offers a glimpse into how the IAF's foundations were laid.

content: Congress criticized the incident adding that this is an organised pattern to humiliate the Dalit community, citing the significance of Agra having a high Scheduled Caste (SC) population

title: Isarda dam project work being expedited to meet water supply targets
content: The project targets supplying water to urban areas through the main pipeline by next month, while the connections will be added in phases in the rural areas where the required water infrastructure has been completed

content: Complainant's lawyer alleges questions focused on her personal and professional background and sought to establish the officer’s credibility; no FIR registered

content: Institutions will have to demonstrate tangible outcomes, such as commercially relevant patents and the number of skilled students produced, rather than merely furnishing documents

content: Former West Bengal Chief Minister says she intends to approach the President on the issue of vote theft and Special Intensive Revision; she is also likely to join the march of India bloc MPs to the Rashtrapati Bhawan on Friday

content: Teachers to use a digital screening tool this month to spot observable behaviours; special educators will then categorise students under 21 disability categories; early detection and intervention to aid inclusive education

title: Cusat shifts classes online amid surge in chickenpox cases
content: Offline classes on Thrikkakara and Marine campuses shifted online till October 16; two chickenpox cases reported last week, with cases surging this week; all infected students asked to leave hostels; scheduled examinations postponed

title: Tamil Nadu may encounter El Niño differently from rest of India
content: In strong El Niño years, pressure differences between the Bay of Bengal and the Arabian Sea can drive moist air into coastal Tamil Nadu; when an El Niño coincides with warmer waters in the Bay, evaporation increases, and cyclonic circulations in November-December release this stored heat as intense, localised rainfall

content: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman says 99% of GST rate and process issues had been addressed but the “door is not closed to further reforms”; all the changes are expected to come into effect from April 1, 2027

content: A memoir titled 'Nox' is considered one of her most profound writings. It's an elegy about her elder brother, Michael Carson, who spent years in India as she hoped to meet him one last time, in vain.
